example.title: Morro Bay Power Plant stacks (1955; the eastern stack)
example.place: Morro Bay, San Luis Obispo County, CA

brief: A tall concrete boiler stack at a harbour power plant, one of three: a smooth tapering off-white concrete shaft with a dark top band, rising from beside a grey box turbine hall on the harbour edge, a landmark for the fishing fleet. Three photos. Older than 1970 (1955): no newer tall stack exists on the West Coast harbours. Scaled to the lot; foundations deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
